artifact_observations.location: Earphone cable connections and control module
artifact_observations.reasoning: The junction where the earphone cables meet the control module and the earbuds themselves lacks crisp mechanical definition. The plastic molding looks slightly soft and fused, lacking the sharp parting lines expected in manufactured electronics.
The inner circle of the click wheel appears slightly elliptical rather than a perfect perspective-projected circle, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI generations.
The screen is uniformly dark/blurry without any pixel grid or reflection details, which is acceptable but lacks realism.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific generation/model classification and distinguish from generic MP3 players.
To verify the physical separation between the device, the cables, and the background surface, ensuring no floating artifacts.
Cables are high-risk areas for fusion and melting artifacts; this expert will check for continuous, non-branching topology.

focus_areas: Mechanical precision of the click wheel (concentricity)
Connectivity points of the earphone wires (fusion checks)
Edge sharpness of the device casing against the background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the earphone assembly. AI often struggles with thin, winding structures like cables. Check if the cables merge into each other or the device incorrectly. Also, verify if the click wheel's buttons (Menu, Play/Pause, etc.) are implied correctly or if they are just a flat grey disc.
